_README: Peripheral arterial occlusive disease, as the Kraiss sVQI-FS pvd item
defines it: SNOMED 399957001 -> OMOP 317309 plus descendants.
DELIBERATELY NOT the [DVI] VA-FI Peripheral vascular disease cohort
(1797955). That cohort is a faithful VA-FI deficit and spans OMOP 321052
peripheral vascular disease, 40479625 atherosclerosis of artery, 317585
aortic aneurysm and 444247 venous thrombosis. Aneurysmal and venous disease
are not peripheral ARTERIAL occlusive disease; a patient scoring the sVQI-FS
pvd item on a DVT is not what the instrument measures.
Note 321052 is an ANCESTOR of 317309, so the VA-FI cohort is a strict
superset here rather than a disjoint set.

PrimaryCriteriaLimit / QualifiedLimit / ExpressionLimit are all "All" and EndStrategy is StartDate+0, unlike the [DVI] VA-FI cohorts (1797948-1797977) which are "First". A first-ever-only cohort cannot answer a lookback-window question.
